comment: DuckDB extensions Tycho self-hosts (CLAUDE.md: self-host the bundles and extensions). scripts/extensions.ts downloads each build into public/duckdb-ext/ (gitignored) and checks its SHA-256. The path mirrors extensions.duckdb.org, since DuckDB builds the URL as <repository>/<version>/<platform>/<name>.duckdb_extension.wasm. The version must match the DuckDB inside @duckdb/duckdb-wasm; bump both together.
